newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hana Bank signs US$100 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Hana Bank signs US$100 mln FRN.

text.p: Hana Bank signed a US$100 million floating rate notes issue due December 2001 with 14 banks on Thursday in Singapore, arranger Dresdner (South East Asia) said.
The five-year notes have a put option and a call option on the third anniversary. They were issued at par to float at 31.5 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier manager is 36.5 basis points.
Arrangers and lead managers are Banca Nazionale del Lavoro SpA Singapore branch, Citicorp International, DKB Asia, Dresdner (South East Asia) and IBJ Asia.
Lead managers are Peregrine Fixed Income, Bank Austria Hong Kong branch and ING Barings.
Bear Stearns Asia is co-lead manager.
Co-managers are CIBC Asia, DIE ERSTE osterreichische Spar-Casse-Bank, Landesbank Schleswig-Holstein Luxembourg branch, Asahi Finance (Hong Kong) and Daiwa Overseas Finance.
